item.title: Tree Hut Creates First Super Bowl Spot, “Uncontain Yourself”
item.description: Source: AdLand.TV Developed in partnership with creative Agency of Record, Bakery, Tree Hut has debuted its first-ever Super Bowl spot, “Uncontain Yourself.” Instead of relying on celebrity endorsements, Tree Hut flipped the traditional Super Bowl formula by casting real fans, creators, and longtime community members in the spot.
